name: graph_source
value: new_expression_snn (not original; original graph / reductions / seurat_clusters absent in the object)

name: hvg_method
value: vst-equivalent on raw counts (Matrix re-implementation of Seurat vst formula, loess span 0.3, clip sqrt(N))

name: pca_method
value: log1p(1e4*count/library) of HVG, gene-wise centred and scaled (upper clip), covariance eigen decomposition, sign-fixed

name: knn
value: exact Euclidean on PCs, self first

name: clustering
value: igraph cluster_louvain on SNN (diagonal excluded), clusters renamed 0.. by size

name: display_layout
value: igraph layout_with_drl on SNN (NOT UMAP; uwot absent in dcta); display only

name: panels_or_labels_used
value: none (no stage panels, author labels or DAG used to build the graph)
